Cross-checked against the SEFAZ-CE official CFOP spreadsheet (https://servicos.sefaz.ce.gov.br/internet/download/arquivos/dief/tabela%20de%20cfop.xls) for code/description structure (that mirror predates the MEI-related text added later, so it was used only to confirm code numbering, not the current wording).
note: All 619 operable CFOP codes currently in force (group/subgroup headings such as 1100, ending in 00/50, are not operable codes and are excluded, matching the CFOP contract).
